messages.subject: Project Quartz — technology transfer kick-off and patent schedule
messages.plaintextBody:
Ingrid,

Now we've completed, let's arrange the clause 4 technology transfer. I'll deliver the AB-COAT(TM) formulations, line parameters and QC protocols within the 30-day window, and we can schedule the first of the 15 assistance days at your Hilden line in January. For reference I attach the agreed schedule of Licensed Patents that forms Schedule 1.

Best,
Marcus
